name: ink-blot-carousel
title: Ink Blot Carousel
description: Full-bleed image slider: the next picture spreads in like ink soaking into paper - a ragged blot blooms from where you tap, with satellite drops. Big serif title + caption bottom-left, counter and round arrows bottom-right, autoplay progress line.
darkMode: always dark stage; `ink` prop sets text/button colour (default white)
mainProps: slides: {image?, title?, caption?, alt?, palette?, seed?}[], height (default 100svh), duration, bleed (edge raggedness), autoplay (ms, default 6000, 0=off), ink, onChange
notes: SVG mask + turbulence, no WebGL - lighter than ink-flow-carousel and works everywhere. Any image host works (no CORS needed). Slides without `image` get a painted landscape (export inkBlotPaintedSlides). Tap, swipe, arrows or arrow keys.
